name: compile_chart
description: Compile a Flint chart spec to a backend-native spec object (Vega-Lite / ECharts / Chart.js) without rendering

arguments.name: data
arguments.desc: Data source; rows provided inline via values

arguments.name: chart_spec
arguments.desc: Chart type and channel encodings to draw

arguments.name: backend
arguments.desc: Rendering backend: vegalite, echarts, or chartjs

arguments.name: field_display_names
arguments.desc: Field name to display label map, used for axis titles and legend headers

arguments.name: semantic_types
arguments.desc: Field name to semantic type map

arguments.name: options
arguments.desc: Assembler options such as tooltips and layout tuning

name: list_chart_types
description: List the available chart types and their encoding channels for a backend, or for all backends when none is given

arguments.name: backend

name: render_chart
description: Compile a Flint chart spec for a backend and render it to a static PNG or SVG image

arguments.name: data
arguments.desc: Data source; rows provided inline via values

arguments.name: chart_spec
arguments.desc: Chart type and channel encodings to draw

arguments.name: backend
arguments.desc: Rendering backend: vegalite, echarts, or chartjs

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: Output format, png or svg (chartjs supports png only)

arguments.name: scale
arguments.desc: Device scale for PNG raster, 1 = design size, 2 = retina

arguments.name: background
arguments.desc: Background color as a CSS color value

arguments.name: field_display_names
arguments.desc: Field name to display label map, used for axis titles and legend headers

arguments.name: semantic_types
arguments.desc: Field name to semantic type map

arguments.name: options
arguments.desc: Assembler options such as tooltips and layout tuning
